name: learned-skills
description: Turns repeated work into reviewable skills. Every few turns a Stop hook starts a background claude -p review of the session transcript (credentials redacted, on your own account), which may create or patch learned-* skills in the project's .claude/skills, with a Learned notice and one-command undo. Off until a project opts in with .claude/learned-skills.json. Optional learning records, a git sink and a disclosure filter for teams.
